title: Fake Obama created using AI video tool - BBC News
summary: A BBC News segment on University of Washington research that synthesized a photorealistic Obama video, modeling mouth movement so any audio can be put in his mouth.
why: Cited as a concrete early example that AI-faked video was already convincing, in discussions of misinformation and trust in media.

quote.text: It's becoming easier and easier to fake image, video, and audio in a way never seen before
